old_caption: The video captures three men standing in an expansive desert landscape under a clear blue sky. The terrain is flat and sandy, with distant mountains forming a serene backdrop. The central figure, dressed in a plaid shirt and black shorts, stands beside a vintage military-style motorcycle with a sidecar. He gestures towards the bike, seemingly explaining its features or history. To his left, another man wearing a dark jacket and jeans holds a small object, possibly a tool or piece of equipment, and appears to be listening attentively. On the right, a third man in a beige jacket and jeans stands with his hands on his hips, observing the scene. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the interaction between the men and their surroundings. The overall atmosphere is calm and focused, suggesting a discussion about the motorcycle or a shared interest in vintage vehicles.

caption: The video captures three men on a pale desert flat, with a low mountain range and partly cloudy sky behind them. A stationary olive-green military motorcycle with a star-marked sidecar sits beside them. In the foreground, a man in a dark sweatshirt, cap, sunglasses and ear muffs holds a dark elongated object in one hand. His head rotates from a left-facing profile toward the camera, and his mouth opens as though speaking. His free hand rises to his hip, then returns to his side. At the center, a bearded man in a plaid shirt and shorts keeps a hand on the handlebar, lifting his gaze to face forward. On the right, a man in a tan sweater and jeans withdraws the hand resting near the headlight and drops it to his side. He then folds both arms across his chest, while the motorcycle and mountains stay fixed and the men hold their positions.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
